known_limits: APK needs signing by the release agent before installation.
The test suite and lint were skipped as requested.
Physical handset sync, gestures, camera and cellular behavior remain unverified.
Live browser rendering could not be inspected because preview requires authentication.
Vercel must have TURSO_DATABASE_URL and TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN in its deployment environment.
Email/password accounts have no email verification or password reset service.
Phone workspace remains bound to the first Pocket account.
Pip chats, photo zines, provider keys, COROS connections and native communication/calendar records are device-local.
Workspace JSON backups exclude photos, chats and zines.
Sync requests are capped at 3 MB and Paper photos at 2 MB.
Generic compatible chat endpoints still require browser CORS and function tool support; live paid providers were not checked.
